translationRepairs: After the Deposed Emperor took the throne, envoys came and went incessantly, too many to count, so those of low rank are generally omitted. Wang Ban is recorded because he was unable to proceed.
After the Fleeing Emperor took the throne, envoys came and went incessantly, too many to count, so those of low rank are generally omitted. Wang Ban is recorded because he was unable to proceed.
Focus unit has 至出帝立; 出帝 is the Fleeing Emperor, not 廢帝 (Deposed Emperor). The before text mislabels the ruler; the proposed Fleeing Emperor matches the Chinese and the chapter’s own title usage.
The Deposed Emperor had promised to spare him, but later ordered Li Shouzhen to have him killed; for that reason the text does not say he was executed.
The Fleeing Emperor had promised to spare him, but later ordered Li Shouzhen to have him killed; for that reason the text does not say he was executed.
Focus unit subjects 出帝 as the one who promised Yang Guangyuan’s life then ordered him killed. Rendering him Deposed Emperor confuses 出帝 with 廢帝; Fleeing Emperor is the accurate English for 出帝.
On jiayin the Goryeo envoy Taixiang arrived.
On jiayin a Goryeo grand minister (taesang) envoy arrived.

Focus unit 高麗使太相來 names only the Goryeo office 太相, with no personal name; parallel s0074 names Jin Renfeng with a title. Treating 太相 as the personal name Taixiang invents an envoy; the proposed title reading (taesang/grand minister) matches the Chinese.
On jichou Li Shouzhen was named overall commander of the field army, with Huang Fuyu of Yicheng as his deputy.
On jichou Li Shouzhen was named overall commander of the field army, with Huangfu Yu of Yicheng as his deputy.
Focus unit has 皇甫遇; 皇甫 is the compound surname Huangfu and 遇 is Yu. Splitting as Huang Fuyu invents a wrong personal name; Huangfu Yu restores the correct reading.
On jichou Li Shouzhen was made overall commander of the campaign headquarters, and Yicheng army commissioner Huang Fuyu was made his deputy.
On jichou Li Shouzhen was made overall commander of the campaign headquarters, and Yicheng army commissioner Huangfu Yu was made his deputy.
The literal field of the same unit likewise mis-splits 皇甫遇 as Huang Fuyu; Huangfu Yu correctly reflects the compound surname and given name.
Although the Deposed Emperor was still alive, Jin had already fallen, so the text writes “destroyed.”
Although the Fleeing Emperor was still alive, Jin had already fallen, so the text writes “destroyed.”
Focus unit 出帝雖存 again names 出帝. Deposed Emperor is the wrong English label; Fleeing Emperor matches 出帝 and the corrected rendering elsewhere in the chapter.
The Fleeing Emperor’s accession was not legitimate, and he severed ties with the man who bore him.
The Fleeing Emperor’s accession was not legitimate, and he severed ties with the one who begot him.

Focus unit 絕其所生, with s0184 identifying Jingru as 出帝父, refers to the birth father. English “bore him” is the wrong verb for a father; “begot him” correctly marks paternal parentage without changing the Chinese sense.
